data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to integrate Google Wallet and save tickets or passes.
data.what_it_does: Allows checking Google Wallet availability on a device and saving passes or tickets into the Google Wallet app using an API client and provided button widgets.
use_when: You need to add event tickets or passes to Google Wallet on Android devices.
You want to display the official 'Add to Google Wallet' button inside your Flutter app.
avoid_when: Your application targets iOS primarily without needing Android Google Wallet integration.
You need a comprehensive cross-platform digital wallet solution supporting both Apple PassKit and Google Wallet in a single unified API.
strengths: Provides pre-built UI components like the 'Add to Google Wallet' button with localization support.
Easily checks wallet API availability on the target Android device.
weaknesses: Limited platform scope (specifically built for Google Wallet on Android).
Requires manual addition of specific SVG assets and localizations in pubspec and MaterialApp configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding specific SVG assets for the Google Wallet buttons to pubspec.yaml and configuring I18nGoogleWallet localizations delegate in MaterialApp.

alternatives.name: wallet
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative package for handling generic digital wallet functionality.

alternatives.name: apple_passkit
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need pass management specifically for Apple Wallet instead of Google Wallet.
